title: Bekenstein's bound for wave packets
summary: Let $B$ be a spatial region of width $2R$ and $Φ$ a Klein-Gordon wave packet localized in $B$ at time zero. We show the inequality $S \leq 2πR E$; here, $S$ is the entropy of $Φ$ contained in a region $B$, and $E$ is the energy content of $Φ$ within $B$. We consider a wider setting and formulate a variational problem aimed at minimizing our bound when $Φ$ is not localized in $B$. Our inequality holds in more generality in the framework of local, Poincaré covariant nets of standard subspaces and is related to the Bekenstein inequality.
